name: Colorist
description: Samples the dominant colour of frames across a video and renders them as a vertical-stripe movie barcode, stored beside the media and shown at the foot of the detail page.

versions.changelog: Barcodes are now stored as the colours that were sampled rather than as a picture of them:

The barcode now spans the full width of the detail page, edge to edge, at the height set in the plugin's settings. It is anchored to the page root rather than to the content container, which carries a 32.45vw left padding on wide layouts to clear the poster and would have indented the strip a third of the way across the screen; any padding on whichever anchor is used is measured and cancelled at render time, and re-measured on resize, because that padding is written in vw and percent and changes with the window. Selectors were taken from the stylesheet a real 10.11.11 server ships rather than guessed. The section heading is gone so the strip reads as a full-bleed band.

Fixes three problems found on a live server. The barcode image now displays: it is loaded by an tag, which cannot send an Authorization header, so the endpoint answered every request with 401 and both the settings preview and the detail-page strip rendered as broken images — the access token now travels in the query string. Frame analysis is capped at the requested stripe count: -skip_frame nokey turned out to be only a hint, and a 110-minute 2160p film was delivering 157,791 frames for a 1,000-stripe barcode, so every frame was scaled and colour-clustered for nothing. HDR and Dolby Vision are converted before their colours are measured, rather than being decoded as though they were SDR — which read far too dark and far too grey, and made every 4K HDR title produce a muted strip. Dolby Vision profile 5, which has no HDR10 base layer and decodes pink and green, is converted with libplacebo so its metadata is actually applied; profiles 7 and 8 use the standard HDR path. If a required ffmpeg filter is missing, sampling falls back a step at a time and logs it rather than producing nothing.
